````{admonition} Theorem 1.3 - Properties of set equality
:label: properties-of-set-equality-theorem
:class: attention

- For any set $A$, $A = A$.
- If $A = B$, then $B = A$
- If $A = B$ and $B = C$, then $A = C$. 
- $A = B$ \Leftrightarrow $A \subseteq B$ and $B \subseteq A$.

## Set difference


```{admonition} Definition 1.9 - Set difference
:label: set-difference-definition

The relative complement of a set B with respect to a set A or, simply, the difference of A
and B, denoted by A\B, is the set of elements which belong to A but which do not belong
to B; that is 𝐴\𝐵 = {𝑥|𝑥 ∈ 𝐴, 𝑥 ∉ 𝐵}
The set A\B is read “A minus B” many texts denote 𝐴\𝐵by 𝐴 − 𝐵.

```
